images_dir.description: Base directory for checkpoint/restore image files (maps to -D).

work_dir.description: Working directory for logs, pidfiles, and stats (maps to -W).

log_file.description: Path to write log messages (maps to -o). Empty string disables file logging.

display_stats.description: Print dump/restore statistics to stdout (maps to --display-stats).

tcp_close.description: Do not checkpoint TCP connections (maps to --tcp-close).

leave_stopped.description: Leave processes stopped after dump/restore instead of killing/resuming (maps to -s).

leave_running.description: Leave processes running after dump (maps to -R); use with caution.

external_mnts.description: List of external bind mounts to dump (maps to --external mnt). Each item is a dict with optional mountpoint and name fields. Use empty string for mountpoint to trigger auto-detect (e.g., mnt[]:name).

external_mnts.items.mountpoint.description: Bind mountpoint to dump; empty string triggers auto-detect.

external_mnts.items.name.description: Identifier used in checkpoint images to refer to this mount.

external_devs.description: List of external block devices to dump (maps to --external dev).

external_unix_sockets.description: List of external UNIX sockets (disconnected ends) to dump (maps to --external unix).

external_unix_sockets.items.id.description: Socket identifier (inode or numeric id from images).

external_pids.description: List of external PID namespaces to mark (maps to --external pid).

external_netns.description: List of external network namespaces to mark (maps to --external net).

external_tty.description: External TTY to dump (maps to --external tty). Set to null to omit.

external_tty.rdev.description: st_rdev from stat(2) of the TTY.

external_tty.dev.description: st_dev from stat(2) of the TTY device.

external_file.description: External file to dump (maps to --external file). Set to null to omit.

action_script.description: Path to external action script. CRTOOLS_SCRIPT_ACTION env var is passed to it.

cgroup_props.description: Cgroup properties in YAML-like literal string (maps to --cgroup-props).

cgroup_props_file.description: Path to file containing cgroup properties (maps to --cgroup-props-file).

inherit_fds.description: List of file descriptors to inherit on restore (maps to --inherit-fd fd[N]:resource).

veth_pair.description: VETH outer/inner device mapping (maps to --veth-pair). Set to null to omit.

restore_root.description: Root filesystem path on restore (maps to -r).

lsm_profile.description: LSM profile to use (maps to --lsm-profile type:name). Set to null to omit.

link_remap.description: Allow linking unlinked files back (maps to --link-remap).

cpu_cap.description: CPU capabilities to validate (maps to --cpu-cap). Valid values: none, fpu, ins, cpu, all.

page_server.description: Page server mode options (maps to page-server command options). Set to null to omit.

page_server.address.description: Page server IP or hostname (maps to --address).

page_server.port.description: Page server port (maps to --port). Use 0 to omit.

page_server.daemon.description: Run page server as daemon (maps to --daemon).

tls.description: TLS configuration for page-server (maps to --tls-cacert/--tls-cert/--tls-key). Set to null to omit.

file_validation.description: File validation mode: 'filesize' or 'buildid' (maps to --file-validation mode).

skip_file_rwx_check.description: Skip file permission checks on restore (maps to --skip-file-rwx-check).
